# ResQ Tyres & Recovery

> Mobile tyre fitting and puncture repair in Leeds and across West Yorkshire, 6am to 10pm every day. We come to the
> vehicle — home, workplace or roadside — with brand-new tyres on board. There is no shop or depot
> to visit; the service is mobile only.

**What we do.** Mobile tyre replacement, with new tyres brought to you and fitted on site. Puncture
repair, where the tyre can be safely repaired — from £70, up to £120 depending on distance and tyre
size. Emergency tyre call-out between 6am and 10pm, seven days a week including bank holidays.
Planned tyre fitting at home or at work. On-site wheel balancing and valve replacement.
Locking wheel-nut removal — we carry the specialist tools.

**What we do not do.** No wheel alignment. No fitting at a garage, shop or depot: there is no
premises to visit. No vehicle recovery — "Recovery" appears in the registered trading name only, and
the services offered are the ones listed above. Bradford (BD postcodes) is outside the coverage area.

**Coverage.** These confirmed postcode districts, and only these: all Leeds districts LS1 to LS29,
including LS24 (Tadcaster); HG1, HG2 and HG3 around Harrogate; WF1 to WF13 across Wakefield,
Castleford, Pontefract, Normanton, Featherstone, Hemsworth, Knottingley and Dewsbury; and in York
YO1 (city centre), YO10 (Fulford, Heslington) and YO24 (Acomb, Dringhouses), plus YO8 (Selby).
WF14 and above, and other YO districts, are outside the area. Towns named on the site are Leeds,
Wakefield, Dewsbury, Pudsey, Morley, Castleford, Garforth, Pontefract, Harrogate, Tadcaster, York
and Selby. Outside those districts, call and ask —
it may still be possible to reach you.

**Hours.** 6am to 10pm, 7 days a week, including bank holidays. Outside those hours, WhatsApp messages are picked up first thing.

**Prices and payment.** Tyre prices are per tyre and vary by size: from £40 each for 14 to 17 inch
wheels and from £80 for 18 to 20 inch, up to about £100 and £150 respectively for premium brands.
Mobile fitting is charged on top, from £50 depending on distance. The exact price is confirmed by
phone before any work starts. 30% off when all four tyres are changed, subject to
availability. No deposit and no online payment — payment is on completion, by card or cash.

**Contact.** Phone 07438 562633 (+44 7438 562633). WhatsApp https://wa.me/447438562633. Email
resqtyresrecovery@gmail.com. Address: Unit 8A, Lavender Walk, Leeds, LS9 8TX, United Kingdom.

**About.** Trading name ResQ Tyres & Recovery. Operating since 2023, based in Leeds.

- [Home](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/): the whole business on one page — services, tyre price guide, coverage and postcode checker, FAQ, and the home-fitting enquiry form.
- [Coverage and postcode checker](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/#areas): the confirmed postcode districts, a coverage map, and a checker that answers whether a given postcode is covered.
- [Mobile tyre fitting in Wakefield](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/mobile-tyre-fitting-wakefield): coverage of WF1 to WF13 by district and place name, services, FAQ. Same phone number, same pay-on-completion terms.
- [Mobile tyre fitting in Harrogate and Tadcaster](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/mobile-tyre-fitting-harrogate): coverage of HG1 to HG3 and LS24 by district and place name, services, FAQ.
- [Jump start in Leeds](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/jump-start-leeds): mobile jump starts for flat batteries at home, work or the roadside, 6am–10pm every day, from £50 (exact price confirmed by phone). Same coverage and pay-on-completion terms.
- [Tyre price guide](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/#estimate): fitted price ranges by tyre size, and the puncture-repair price.
- [Questions we get asked](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/#faq): plain answers on call-out hours, punctures, coverage, cost, payment, locking wheel nuts and wheel alignment.
- [Services](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/#services): mobile tyre fitting and puncture repair, and emergency call-out 6am–10pm.
- [Plan a home tyre fitting](https://www.resqtyres.co.uk/#enquiry): enquiry form for a booked fitting at home or work.
